name: mystmd@1.14.0
body:
([full changelog](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/compare/mystmd@1.13.0...2174dbced3ae6ebeb292f02c401186400d697c0e))

## Enhancements made

- 👯‍♀️ Fix duplicate markdown directive argument parsing [#3118](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3118) ([@fwkoch](https://github.com/fwkoch), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77), [@choldgraf](https://github.com/choldgraf))

## Bugs fixed

- Pass BASE_URL to the `render` command [#3156](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3156) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Restore removed tests for hidden pages [#3142](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3142) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Fix LaTeX inline code and listings conversion [#3128](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3128) ([@Consciencieux](https://github.com/Consciencieux), [@choldgraf](https://github.com/choldgraf))
- Run the error assertion in the invalid button body test [#3121](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3121) ([@dylanpulver](https://github.com/dylanpulver), [@choldgraf](https://github.com/choldgraf))
- 🎥 Keep remote image URLs when the download fails and accept remote videos [#3103](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3103) ([@mayuriphad](https://github.com/mayuriphad), [@choldgraf](https://github.com/choldgraf))

## Maintenance and upkeep improvements

- Add new `.lintstagedrc` for Husky [#3149](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3149) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Update eslint to 10 [#3147](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3147) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Switch to `oxfmt` for code formatting [#3146](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3146) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Update vitest to 5.1 [#3145](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3145) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Update turbo to 2.11 [#3144](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3144) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Upgrade changesets to v3 [#3143](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3143) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Upgrade to unified 11 [#3107](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3107) ([@ciyer](https://github.com/ciyer), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77), [@choldgraf](https://github.com/choldgraf), [@claude](https://github.com/claude))

## Documentation improvements

- Document URL redirects [#3152](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3152) ([@choldgraf](https://github.com/choldgraf), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Document Plausible script URL for analytics_plausible [#3150](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3150) ([@stefanv](https://github.com/stefanv), [@choldgraf](https://github.com/choldgraf))

## Other merged PRs

- Version Packages [#3148](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3148) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- 🚀 Release [#3120](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3120) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
